Massive Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook, Teams, Copilot worldwide

claims.statement: A major outage disrupted Microsoft 365 services including Outlook, Teams and Copilot worldwide.
Microsoft initially described the issue as elevated load on its systems.

sources.quote: Microsoft said the outage was caused by servers unexpected becoming unavailable, straining other systems.

claims.statement: Microsoft said the outage was caused by servers unexpectedly becoming unavailable, straining other systems.

claims.statement: Microsoft had not completely ruled out a cyberattack as a cause of the incident.

claims.statement: Microsoft later said the outage was not caused by a cyber-security incident.

claims.statement: Microsoft ultimately attributed the outage to a bad update rather than a cyberattack or AI.

discrepancies.explanation: One report says Microsoft had not completely ruled out a cyberattack as the cause, while a later report says Microsoft confirmed the outage was not caused by a cyber-security incident.

the outage was not caused by a cyber-security incident

discrepancies.explanation: Outlets gave different figures for the outage's length, from a report of it stretching past 27 hours to a headline calling it a 24-hour outage and another describing it as an almost two-day outage.

analysis.headline: Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook, Teams worldwide for a day
analysis.summary: A widespread Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook, Teams and Copilot worldwide, affecting governments, hospitals and schools. Microsoft initially cited elevated load, then said servers unexpectedly became unavailable, and finally blamed a bad update rather than a cyberattack. Reports differ on whether a cyberattack was ruled out early on and on the outage's total duration.
